titles.title: You Are the Lord (feat. Jessica Barron)

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Every other god is an idol
Who cannot see and cannot hear
There is One true living God
There is One true living God

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
You are the Lord, You are the Lord
There is no other God
You are the Lord forevermore
And You shall reign

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
His name is Jesus
His name is Jesus

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Every other well is broken
It cannot fill or satisfy
You're the One true living God

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Only You can satisfy
Only You can satisfy us
